Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，急，能帮个忙不
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, something came up, can you help

Content.SourceString: 什么事这么急？
Content.LocalizedString: What's so urgent?

Content.SourceString: 我在查案，被治安所当成可疑人物了，，
Content.LocalizedString: I was on a case, but the security office thinks I'm suspicious,,

Content.SourceString: 你带着管理局的证件吧，这样还不能自证吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Can't you just show the ID you got from the Bureau?

Content.SourceString: 在暗中调查一个案子，不能明示身份
Content.LocalizedString: I'm supposed to be undercover, I can't show that

Content.SourceString: 否则可能打草惊蛇
Content.LocalizedString: Otherwise someone might get spooked

Content.SourceString: 原来如此，那要我帮你什么？
Content.LocalizedString: I see. How can I help?

Content.SourceString: 得麻烦你来一趟，帮我证明一下身份了，，
Content.LocalizedString: Sorry to bother you, but could you come by and help verify my identity?

Content.SourceString: 毕竟你是伊波恩的，这边人对你熟
Content.LocalizedString: You're from Eibon so people should know you

Content.SourceString: 行，我这就来。
Content.LocalizedString: Alright, I'll be right there.

Content.SourceString: 行，我这就来。
Content.LocalizedString: Alright, I'll be right there.

Content.SourceString: 有点郁闷 在想要不要去上晴塔蹦极
Content.LocalizedString: I'm so bored I want to go bungee jumping on Hethereau Skytower

OptionText.LocalizedString: What are you going to do?

Content.SourceString: 你想干嘛？
Content.LocalizedString: What are you going to do?

Content.SourceString: 啊我随便打的字 怎么发出去了
Content.LocalizedString: Oh I was just typing, how did it get sent out

Content.SourceString: 完了，没法取消
Content.LocalizedString: Oh no, I can't cancel it

Content.SourceString: 其实那个功能叫「撤回」。
Content.LocalizedString: Actually, the function is called "delete."

Content.SourceString: 怎么撤回，，，，算了
Content.LocalizedString: How do I do that,,,, forget it

Content.SourceString: 要来上晴塔玩吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Wanna come to the Hethereau Skytower?

Content.SourceString: 好突然的邀请。
Content.LocalizedString: That's a random invite.

Content.SourceString: 路过想上去看看风景
Content.LocalizedString: I just passed by and wanted to take a look up there

Content.SourceString: 但是自己一个人上去感觉会很惆怅啊
Content.LocalizedString: But I thought I'd be sad and lonely if I went there just by myself

Content.SourceString: 所以问问你要不要一起
Content.LocalizedString: That's why I asked you to join me

Content.SourceString: 为什么找我，不找队友一起吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Why ask me instead of your teammates?

Content.SourceString: 我那几个队友，，你确定吗
Content.LocalizedString: Those teammates,, are you sure

Content.SourceString: 这样啊……诶对了，你上次说要请我吃饭。
Content.LocalizedString: Oh… anyway, you did say you were going to buy me a meal.

Content.SourceString: 上晴塔那边好像有个餐厅，我请你！
Content.LocalizedString: There's a restaurant up there in the Skytower. I'll pay!

Content.SourceString: 你还欠我一顿饭呢，正好上晴塔有个餐厅……
Content.LocalizedString: You still owe me a meal. The Skytower happens to have a restaurant…

Content.SourceString: 好，请你吃
Content.LocalizedString: Right, I'll buy you a meal

Content.SourceString: 来吧来吧，我在一楼电梯口等你！
Content.LocalizedString: Come over, I'll be waiting at the elevator on 1F!

Content.SourceString: 来吧来吧，我在一楼电梯口等你！
Content.LocalizedString: Come over, I'll be waiting at the elevator on 1F!

Content.SourceString: 嗨 醒着吗
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, you awake?

Content.SourceString: 来看海吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Wanna see the ocean?

Content.SourceString: 怎么突然想到要来看海？
Content.LocalizedString: Why do you suddenly want to see the ocean?

Content.SourceString: 好。去哪里？
Content.LocalizedString: Sure, where at?

Content.SourceString: 有事路过，看到风景不错
Content.LocalizedString: I passed by and found a great view

Content.SourceString: 你都不问为什么吗？
Content.LocalizedString: You're not asking why?

Content.SourceString: 又是路过啊。那给我个地址吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Passing by again? Give me an address.

Content.SourceString: 正好我也想看，就不问了。
Content.LocalizedString: I also wanted to see the ocean. No questions needed.

Content.SourceString: 这么巧啊，那好，
Content.LocalizedString: Great. That worked out for both of us,

Content.SourceString: 我在星渚游艇码头等你
Content.LocalizedString: I'll wait for you at Stellar Marina.

Content.SourceString: 我在星渚游艇码头等你
Content.LocalizedString: I'll wait for you at Stellar Marina.

Content.SourceString: 嘿，有没有兴趣一起晨跑
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, wanna do a morning run together

Content.SourceString: 晨跑？什么时间，什么路线？
Content.LocalizedString: Morning run? When and where?

Content.SourceString: 早上五点，从半角街的塔出发，去绿墙坡绕几圈
Content.LocalizedString: 5 am, starting from the tower at Hankaku Street to take a few laps at Green Wall Slope

Content.SourceString: 然后我拐去管理局上班
Content.LocalizedString: Then I'll make a turn to the Bureau for work

Content.SourceString: 好早……
Content.LocalizedString: So early…

Content.SourceString: 毕竟晚了就赶不上上班了嘛。而且早晨空气更清新
Content.LocalizedString: I'll be late for work if I start late. The air is fresh in the morning too

Content.SourceString: 但是为什么问我要不要一起，晨跑用不着结伴吧。
Content.LocalizedString: But why do you want me to join you on a morning run?

Content.SourceString: 而且我大概率跟不上你的速度，也起不了这么早……
Content.LocalizedString: I probably can't keep up with your speed and I can't wake up that early…

Content.SourceString: 也是哦。
Content.LocalizedString: I guess that's true.

Content.SourceString: 我就是想到离桥间地挺近，顺便问下
Content.LocalizedString: I just thought Bridge Crossings was close and wanted to ask

Content.SourceString: 打扰啦！
Content.LocalizedString: Hope I'm not bothering you!

Content.SourceString: 没关系。
Content.LocalizedString: It's alright.

Content.SourceString: 话说你起这么早不会困吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Don't you get tired when you wake up early?

Content.SourceString: 不会啊 睡够了就不困啊
Content.LocalizedString: As long as I slept enough the last night

Content.SourceString: 你每天晚上几点睡觉？
Content.LocalizedString: When do you usually go to bed in the night?

Content.SourceString: 十点
好早！
Content.LocalizedString: So early!

Content.SourceString: 朋友，有没有多的口罩
Content.LocalizedString: Friend, do you have a spare facemask

Content.SourceString: 我没有戴口罩的习惯……话说你不是自己有个面罩吗？
Content.LocalizedString: I don't usually wear facemasks… I thought you had a mask?

Content.SourceString: 你不是自己有个面罩吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Don't you have your own mask?

Content.SourceString: 我那个不知道塞哪去了
Content.LocalizedString: I dunno were I left it

Content.SourceString: 过会还要出任务，不知道怎么办了
Content.LocalizedString: I got a mission soon. I dunno what to do

OptionText.LocalizedString: Do you need to wear a mask?

Content.SourceString: 就算没有面罩之类的，也不影响吧？
Content.LocalizedString: You can still complete your mission without a mask, right?

Content.SourceString: 毕竟好像和你的作战没关系？
Content.LocalizedString: It's not like you can't fight without one, right?

Content.SourceString: ，，，你就当是心理原因吧
Content.LocalizedString: ,,, Just imagine I need it for psychological reasons

Content.SourceString: 什么心理原因？
Content.LocalizedString: What kind of psychological reasons?

Content.SourceString: 额就是，你不觉得跟人战斗的时候被人看见脸很奇怪吗
Content.LocalizedString: I mean, isn't it strange when someone stares at your face when you fight

OptionText.LocalizedString: You don't want them to seek revenge?

Content.SourceString: 你的意思是，怕被对方记住样子之后被报仇吗
Content.LocalizedString: Do you mean you don't want them to know your face and seek revenge later?

Content.SourceString: 不是这个意思
Content.LocalizedString: That's not what I mean

Content.SourceString: 就是，战斗的时候肯定面目狰狞啊
Content.LocalizedString: You know, when you fight, your face could get distorted

Content.SourceString: 那样看起来很不好吧！
Content.LocalizedString: That doesn't look great, right

Content.SourceString: 我理解不了。
Content.LocalizedString: I don't get it.

Content.SourceString: 我好像理解了。
Content.LocalizedString: I think I get it.

Content.SourceString: 好吧，，
Content.LocalizedString: Okay,,

Content.SourceString: 你的意思是不想给人留下坏印象？
Content.LocalizedString: You mean you don't want to leave a bad impression?

Content.SourceString: ，，，也不太准确！不过这不重要了
Content.LocalizedString: ,,, that's not it! But it doesn't matter that much

Content.SourceString: 我再去问问别人吧
Content.LocalizedString: Let me ask others

Content.SourceString: 对管理局食堂有兴趣不
Content.LocalizedString: Are you interested in the food court at the Bureau

Content.SourceString: 你下次来我可以带你去，刷我工卡不要钱
Content.LocalizedString: I can get you in next time. You don't need to pay

Content.SourceString: 原来管理局还有食堂啊。
Content.LocalizedString: I didn't know there was a food court in the Bureau.

Content.SourceString: 下次去看看。不过饭钱我还是照常给你吧。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll go check it out, but I can pay for my own food.

Content.SourceString: 不用，我卡里钱多刷不完
Content.LocalizedString: It's alright, my card has too many Fons to spend

Content.SourceString: 我不怎么吃食堂
Content.LocalizedString: I don't usually go to food courts

Content.SourceString: 因为难吃吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Does it taste bad?

Content.SourceString: 也不是，食堂味道挺正常的
Content.LocalizedString: Not really, the food is pretty standard

Content.SourceString: 但我还是习惯自己带饭
Content.LocalizedString: I just like bringing my own food

OptionText.LocalizedString: Does someone meal prep for you?

Content.SourceString: 你自己做的饭？
Content.LocalizedString: You prep your own meals?

Content.SourceString: 别人帮你做的饭吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Does someone meal prep for you?

Content.SourceString: 对
Content.LocalizedString: Yep

Content.SourceString: 哪来的别人
Content.LocalizedString: There's no other

Content.SourceString: 我自己做的
Content.LocalizedString: I prep them myself

Content.SourceString: 这么多年自己做饭习惯了，所以老是忘记有食堂
Content.LocalizedString: I'm used to making my own food, so I always forget there's a food court

Content.SourceString: 好奇你做的饭是什么味道……
Content.LocalizedString: I'm curious what your food tastes like…

Content.SourceString: 有机会我给你带一份？
Content.LocalizedString: Then I'll bring you a meal some time?

Content.SourceString: 好啊好啊。
Content.LocalizedString: Alright then.

Content.SourceString: 呃不过你别对味道有太多期待
Content.LocalizedString: Oh but don't expect it to be out of the ordinary

OptionText.LocalizedString: As long as I get free food

Content.SourceString: 没事，能蹭到一顿饭我就很满足了。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm satisfied as long as I get a free meal.

Content.SourceString: 放心，我不会有期待的！
Content.LocalizedString: Don't worry, I won't have high expectations!

Content.SourceString: 那我拿个大点的饭盒装
Content.LocalizedString: Then I'll bring a bigger box

Content.SourceString: ，，行那我也放心了
Content.LocalizedString: ,, that works for me

Content.SourceString: 我今天才发现泯除方块还有街机版
Content.LocalizedString: I just realized Tetrominoes have an arcade version

Content.SourceString: 之前一直在手机上玩
Content.LocalizedString: I've been playing on my phone

Content.SourceString: 这游戏好玩吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Do you have fun playing that game?

Content.SourceString: 我今天才发现泯除方块还有手机版
Content.LocalizedString: I didn't know there was a phone version for Tetrominoes.

Content.SourceString: 可太好玩了
Content.LocalizedString: It's super fun

Content.SourceString: 所以你也玩？
Content.LocalizedString: You play too?

Content.SourceString: 要不要找机会一起玩
Content.LocalizedString: Wanna play together?

Content.SourceString: 这种类型的游戏……好像没有一起玩的必要吧？
Content.LocalizedString: This game… You don't necessarily have to play with another person, right?

Content.SourceString: 什么
Content.LocalizedString: Huh

Content.SourceString: 我不太懂，，什么样的游戏才有结伴的必要
Content.LocalizedString: I don't get it,, what game must be played with another person

Content.SourceString: 联机游戏，比如「爆！拳王」之类的。
Content.LocalizedString: Multiplayer games, like Burst King.

Content.SourceString: 结伴一起的话，就可以互相切磋了。
Content.LocalizedString: We could test each other's skills.

Content.SourceString: 这样啊，
Content.LocalizedString: I see,

Content.SourceString: 这个爆拳王我玩过，按钮按不明白
Content.LocalizedString: I've played that Burst King game before, but I couldn't get the buttons

Content.SourceString: 不过挺有意思的，我再练练，就可以一起玩了
Content.LocalizedString: It's still interesting. I'll practice some more so we can play together

Content.SourceString: 等你练成！
Content.LocalizedString: I'll be waiting for you to get good!

Content.SourceString: 其实我也不会玩，你要是学会了肯定能赢我。
Content.LocalizedString: Actually, I'm not that good. You'll beat me up in no time.

Content.SourceString: 不说了我去查攻略了
Content.LocalizedString: Alright I gotta look up some tips

Content.SourceString: 那等我学会了教你
Content.LocalizedString: I'll teach you then

Content.LocalizedString: Likeability_biaoqing_004

Content.SourceString: 你好，很高兴认识你
Content.LocalizedString: Greetings, I'm glad to have met you.

Content.SourceString: 你好。
Content.LocalizedString: Hello.

Content.SourceString: 好正式的打招呼方式……
Content.LocalizedString: That was rather stiff greeting…

Content.SourceString: 也可以不那么正式啦！
Content.LocalizedString: I dun have to be that formal!

Content.SourceString: 好吧，打完招呼就不知道该说啥了
Content.LocalizedString: Umm, I dunno what to say after greeting you

Content.SourceString: ……可以不说，然后，就这样，回见？
Content.LocalizedString: …You don't have to say anything more. Maybe, "That's it, see you next time?"

Content.SourceString: 也是啦。但接下来还要合作，熟络一下总是好的
Content.LocalizedString: That works, but since we're going to work together, it's better to know each other

Content.SourceString: 对了，你是鉴定师
Content.LocalizedString: Ah right, you're the Appraiser

Content.SourceString: 我挺好奇的，鉴定师的工作，就是每天在店里分辨东西的真假吗
Content.LocalizedString: I'm curious about your work. Do you stay in Eibon and tell real antiques from fake ones all day?

Content.SourceString: 是的，差不多就这样……不过不是古董而是异象。
Content.LocalizedString: That's about right… but I work with anomalies, not antiques.

Content.SourceString: 一眼就能看出来？
Content.LocalizedString: You can tell one at a glance?

Content.SourceString: 一眼……可以这么说吧。
Content.LocalizedString: A glance… I guess you could say that.

Content.SourceString: 就没有人怀疑过你的判断吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Has anyone ever challenged your appraisals?

Content.SourceString: 换句话说，其他人为什么会这么相信你？
Content.LocalizedString: I mean, why do others trust you so much?

Content.SourceString: 因为我的判断一直都没有出过错……？
Content.LocalizedString: I've never made a wrong call…?

Content.SourceString: 因为我就是很厉害
Content.LocalizedString: Because I'm just good at this.

Content.SourceString: 一直没出错，并不能证明未来不会出错
Content.LocalizedString: That doesn't mean you won't make a mistake in the future

Content.SourceString: 哈哈哈 也是，我在管理局听过一些关于你的事，确实很了不得
Content.LocalizedString: Hahaha I get it. I heard about you in the BAC. Good stuff

Content.SourceString: ，，不过这也是诡辩啦，换我也会选择信你的
Content.LocalizedString: ,, ah I'm not trying to argue. I'll choose to trust you too

Content.SourceString: 之所以提起这个，是因为我觉得自己有一眼分辨罪犯的能力，但大家好像都不太相信
Content.LocalizedString: I mentioned this because I always thought I was good at telling who's a criminal, but ppl don't seem to believe me

Content.SourceString: 为什么？
Content.LocalizedString: Why not?

Content.SourceString: 因为出过一些错，也没有特别厉害的背景加成……
Content.LocalizedString: I've made some wrong calls, and I don't have any related powers…

Content.SourceString: 跟你这种确定的「力量」相比，果然还是不太一样啊
Content.LocalizedString: Your powers are really something else

Content.SourceString: 哎呀 抱歉，聊到无关的事了
Content.LocalizedString: Ah sorry, I digress

Content.SourceString: 没关系。
Content.LocalizedString: It's alright.

Content.SourceString: 明明很相关啊，我们这不就熟络起来了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: You're on topic. We carried on a conversation after all.

Content.SourceString: 你说得对，朋友
Content.LocalizedString: You're right, friend

Content.SourceString: 那就先这样咯，回见！
Content.LocalizedString: Well, that's about it. See ya!

Content.SourceString: 来爬树吗？之前约过的
Content.LocalizedString: Wanna climb a tree? We talked about it

Content.SourceString: 什么爬树？
Content.LocalizedString: Climb what tree?

Content.SourceString: 真爬啊？还以为只是你随口一说。
Content.LocalizedString: Really? I thought you were just saying.

Content.SourceString: 就是那个啦、调查康斯坦丁旧宅时候说的
Content.LocalizedString: You know, the one we talked about at the Constantine mansion

Content.SourceString: 不过肯定不能爬当时那棵
Content.LocalizedString: I don't think we should climb the tree at that time

Content.SourceString: 我在海特洛东南方位发现一棵大树，要不要过来
Content.LocalizedString: I found a massive tree in southeast Hethereau, wanna come over

Content.SourceString: 你指的不会是愿木坡的福荫木吧？
Content.LocalizedString: You mean the Fortune Shade at Yuanmu Hill?

Content.SourceString: 啊这地方这么出名吗
Content.LocalizedString: Oh it's a famous place?

OptionText.LocalizedString: Everyone in Hethereau knows about it.

Content.SourceString: 海特洛人都知道。
Content.LocalizedString: Everyone in Hethereau knows about it.

Content.SourceString: 这样啊。这树又高又大，爬上去不用怕树枝折断，很合适
Content.LocalizedString: I see. This tree is huge and tall and you won't have to worry about it's branches breaking. It's good for climbing

OptionText.LocalizedString: But it's a tree of wishes

Content.SourceString: 但这是许愿树，爬上去不太好吧……
Content.LocalizedString: But It's probably inappropriate to climb on a tree people wish on

Content.SourceString: 原来你信这个啊。
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, didn't know you believed in these things.

Content.SourceString: 嗯。
Content.LocalizedString: Yep.

Content.SourceString: 也不能说信吧，至少……需要尊重一下？
Content.LocalizedString: Can't say I believe in it, but at least… I respect their wishes?

Content.SourceString: 有道理
Content.LocalizedString: Makes sense

Content.SourceString: 那来都来了我许个愿再走吧
Content.LocalizedString: I might as well make wish before I leave

Content.SourceString: 在这里许愿的人，许下的愿望都能实现
Content.LocalizedString: May all the wishes of all who wishes here come true

Content.SourceString: ↑我的愿望，写上去了
Content.LocalizedString: ↑ That's the wish I made

OptionText.LocalizedString: Thought you didn't believe in these things

Content.SourceString: 还以为你不信这个
Content.LocalizedString: Thought you didn't believe in these things

Content.SourceString: 也不能说信吧，反正写上去又没坏处
Content.LocalizedString: Can't say I believe in them, but it doesn't hurt to make a wish

Content.SourceString: 你有什么愿望不，，我可以代写
Content.LocalizedString: Do you have any wishes,, I can make it for you

Content.SourceString: 代写没用吧，毕竟是自己的愿望
Content.LocalizedString: That's not how it works. It's another person's wish.

Content.SourceString: 我刚写的愿望好像也不能算我自己的愿望
Content.LocalizedString: Well, the wish I just made isn't quite my own too

Content.SourceString: 哎不行我脑袋乱了
Content.LocalizedString: Uh I'm getting confused now

Content.SourceString: 等我去找棵好爬的树再说
Content.LocalizedString: Let me find a good tree to climb
Sounds good…

Content.SourceString: 别忘了去许愿，有我的愿望在前，会很灵的！
Content.LocalizedString: Don't forget to make a wish. My wish will help your wish come true!

Content.SourceString: 你还是承认自己信这个了。
Content.LocalizedString: You just admitted that you believe in this stuff.

Content.SourceString: 我可没说！
Content.LocalizedString: I did not!

Content.SourceString: 好久不见，
Content.LocalizedString: Been a while,

Content.SourceString: 不过也没有很久吧
Content.LocalizedString: It hasn't been that long

Content.SourceString: 也没有很久吧。
Content.LocalizedString: It hasn't been too long.

Content.SourceString: 感觉是很久了。
Content.LocalizedString: It felt long.

Content.SourceString: 没想到还能活下来
Content.LocalizedString: We actually survived

Content.SourceString: 会不会其实我们现在在冥界什么的地方发短信啊
Content.LocalizedString: Or are we actually texting somewhere in the underworld?

Content.SourceString: 没有那种地方……大家都还好好的。
Content.LocalizedString: There's no such place… Everyone is doing well.

Content.SourceString: 最后那艘船 开得还真稳啊
Content.LocalizedString: That boat, was pretty steady

Content.SourceString: 说到船……你以前就在船上待过很久吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Speaking of boats… You stayed on a boat for a long time, right?

Content.SourceString: 对哦，我有跟你聊过
Content.LocalizedString: Yes, I did tell you about that

Content.SourceString: 其实船来接我们走的时候，我就觉得这是我临死的幻觉了
Content.LocalizedString: When the boat came to pick us up, I thought I was hallucinating before my death

Content.SourceString: 完全就是走马灯啊
Content.LocalizedString: My life flashed before me

OptionText.LocalizedString: The boat you were on before…

Content.SourceString: 你之前在的那艘船，现在还存在吗？
Content.LocalizedString: The boat you were on before… Is it still there?

Content.SourceString: 不知道
Content.LocalizedString: I dunno

Content.SourceString: 船上的老朋友应该都还在吧，，
Content.LocalizedString: Some of my old friends on the boat should be still there,,

Content.SourceString: 不知道。音讯全无
Content.LocalizedString: But I dunno, haven't heard anything from them

Content.SourceString: 没有找过他们吗？
Content.LocalizedString: You never visited them?

Content.SourceString: 没必要找啊。分开了就是分开了，再找回去也太那啥了
Content.LocalizedString: I don't need to. We've parted ways already. Why would I go back

Content.SourceString: 万一对方过得特别好或者特别惨咋办
Content.LocalizedString: What if they're doing really well or really bad

Content.SourceString: 出现这种情况的话，照理说应该互相帮助？
Content.LocalizedString: Theoretically, shouldn't you have each other's backs?

Content.SourceString: 还有这种事？
Content.LocalizedString: Is that so?

Content.SourceString: 那我还是希望大家都过得差不多
Content.LocalizedString: Then I do hope everyone is doing just as well as each other
